scope: Read-only independent cross-review; no changes to groups B/C.
conclusion: No material disagreement with the two proposals.

new_000023.finding: The upper row22 fragment is visible in the central gripper aperture and the narrow strip to its right. The latter strip remains left of the dark vertical inter-column divider near x806-812. Row25 belongs to the neighboring right stack beyond the divider, so the proposed row22 envelope does not duplicate row25.
new_000023.lower_extent: The soft horizontal transition near y477 separates the lower aperture triangle. The lower proposal x689-719,y477-493 encloses that visible fragment. Its extent is limited by the gripper opening, not interpreted as a complete cassette width. Both actual lower-front corners remain hidden.
new_000023.qualification: The two-instance split follows the explicit user adjudication and orange reference; the original pixels support the proposed seam and visible envelopes. Soft seam uncertainty is about 2-3 px; this is not a calibrated confidence interval.

new_000051.finding: The original contains two separated visible portions of this same cassette front: a left strip beside the gripper and the white/gray front patch in the aperture. Their union is consistent with this box. The prior y428.43 top reached into the upper neighbor; the tighter bottom excludes the darker area below the aperture patch.
new_000051.right_corner: Preserving canonical missing is correct. The right side of the aperture is an occlusion boundary, not an independently visible actual cassette corner.
new_000051.qualification: The aperture upper transition is soft, around y433-436; nominal y435 is defensible. About 2-3 px contour uncertainty. No material disagreement.
